task.description: WF-02 Step 2c (Security gate, mandatory for every apps/bot/** requirement) for REQ-033 on branch feature/WF02-REQ-033. Read git diff master...HEAD directly. Run every applicable item of docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md (S1-S14) against it, constructing the negative case for each. This diff is schema + a pure code-value generator only -- no handlers, no auth, no PII flow -- so most items (S1, S2, S3, S5, S6, ...) are legitimately N/A, but each must be marked N/A WITH THE REASON, never silently skipped. The one item that clearly DOES apply is S4 (Tokens are unguessable and single-purpose -- explicitly names InviteCode values, >=128 bits from a CSPRNG, never Math.random/sequential/hash-derived). Verify S4 by reading apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.ts directly and constructing the negative case yourself (what would a violation look like, and confirm the actual code does not do that) -- not by accepting REVIEWER or BACKEND-DEV's prior sign-off. Also check whether the invite_codes.expires_at / max_uses enforcement half of S4 ("a code accepted past expires_at or beyond max_uses") applies here -- this requirement adds the COLUMNS only, no redemption logic yet (that is REQ-038), so state explicitly whether that enforcement half is N/A for THIS diff specifically (deferred to REQ-038) or a gap.
acceptance_criteria: Every applicable S1-S14 item explicitly addressed: PASS with the negative case constructed, or N/A with a stated reason -- no silent skip
S4 verified by reading the actual generator code, negative case constructed (what a violation would look like), not accepted on trust
The expires_at/max_uses enforcement question addressed explicitly: N/A-deferred-to-REQ-038, or a real gap in this diff
FAIL cites file, line, and invariant number; PASS states what was checked and how the negative case was constructed

result.summary: S1-S14 run against git diff master...HEAD (schema.ts, 0007_sturdy_network.sql, inviteCode.ts, inviteCode.test.ts). S4 (generation half): PASS, verified by reading apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.ts directly. generateInviteCode() calls node:crypto randomBytes(26) (line 33) -- a real CSPRNG, never Math.random, never a counter, never derived from a user id or any predictable input. byte % 32 (line 35) is unbiased since 256/32=8 exactly. 26 bytes -> 26*log2(32)=130 bits >= the 128-bit S4 floor. Negative case constructed against each listed violation: predictable derivation (none -- output depends only on randomBytes), insufficient entropy (130>=128), Math.random (absent from source; also asserted at runtime by inviteCode.test.ts's Math.random-spy test, which I read), sequential/hash-derived (no counter, no createHash anywhere in the module). DB backstop: 0007_sturdy_network.sql line 15 creates a UNIQUE INDEX on invite_codes.code matching schema.ts's uniqueIndex, so even a collision would be rejected rather than silently accepted. S4 (expires_at/max_uses enforcement half): N/A-deferred to REQ-038. This diff adds only the expires_at and max_uses COLUMNS (schema.ts inviteCodes table) with zero redemption/validation logic anywhere in the diff -- no handler checks expires_at against now() or used_count against max_uses, because no redemption code path exists yet in this diff to violate the invariant. Not a gap in this diff; flagged for REQ-038's SECURITY-REVIEWER pass to verify for real, including the atomic-increment/read-then-write race on used_count under concurrent redemption (same class of concern as S7). S13 migration sign-off (given per this role's mandatory duty, read from the actual .sql not a description): PASS. 0007_sturdy_network.sql is purely additive -- one CREATE TABLE, three ADD CONSTRAINT FKs, one unique index -- no DROP/RENAME/ALTER COLUMN touching any existing column, no personal-data or attendance column removed or rewritten, nothing that could retroactively change a past event's published figures. All new FKs (invite_codes.event_id, issued_to_user_id, grants_companion_of; registrations.invite_code_id) are ON DELETE RESTRICT, consistent with the schema's anonymize-not-cascade pattern. Remaining items N/A with reason, no silent skips: S1 N/A (no consent writes; invite_codes carries no personal-data fields, only code/event/optional user-FKs/counts/timestamps). S2 N/A (no handler or role-check surface exists in this diff). S3 N/A (no read path added). S5 N/A (no check-in logic). S6 N/A (registrations.checked_in_at untouched, only its invite_code_id FK target changed). S7 N/A (no capacity/admission logic touched). S8 N/A (no status-change code path; invite_codes rows aren't written by any code in this diff -- creation is REQ-037's). S9 N/A (no notification code). S10 N/A (no messaging code). S11 N/A (no logging added; code column is a generated token, not PII). S12 N/A (no export code). S14 N/A (no speaker/Profile publication code).
